item.title: Hungary ousts Orban as Magyar's party wins supermajority in parliament
item.summary: Hungarian voters delivered a shock election result on Sunday, ending Viktor Orban’s 16-year rule and handing victory to pro-European challenger Peter Magyar, in a vote set to reshape Hungary’s ties with the EU and reverberate across global far-right movements.

item.title: Trump orders naval blockade of Strait of Hormuz after failed US-Iran talks
item.summary: President Donald Trump said the US Navy will begin a blockade of the Strait of Hormuz Monday morning after US-Iran ceasefire talks in Pakistan collapsed without agreement. This announcement fuelled fears of further disruption to global energy supplies and shipping routes.
